analysis.reason: RSI가 21.4에서 29.9로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램 역시 -6.2266에서 -3.7941로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 회복 가능성. 그러나 SMA20($317.44) 및 SMA50($332.91) 등 주요 이동평균선 하단에 위치하며 여전히 약세 구간. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.71배로 위축되어 추세 전환 신뢰도 낮음. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold, moving from 21.4 to 29.9. MACD histogram also improves from -6.2266 to -3.7941, signaling bottoming. 5-day low is higher than 20-day low, suggesting recovery potential. However, price remains below key moving averages like SMA20 ($317.44) and SMA50 ($332.91), indicating a weak zone. Volume at 0.71x the 5-day average is subdued, lowering confidence in a trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($284.78) vs SMA5/20/50 ($283.06/$317.44/$332.91): Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50, confirming entry into a weak zone.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($341.40/$339.22): Below long-term moving averages, indicating a continued weak trend.
· 52-week position (10.2%) + Historical significance of current price range: 5.1% above the 52-week low ($270.70), entering a zone of attempted recovery.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (21.4→29.9) + Attempting to exit oversold, with expectations of directional recovery.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.2266→-3.7941) + Diagnosed as improving, confirming bottoming signals.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $262.31) + Bandwidth at 34.73% is wide, suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($276.92) + Based on 5-day/20-day lows, further downside possible on breach.
· Swing resistance level ($291.59) + Aligns with Pivot R1 level, breakthrough could strengthen short-term rebound momentum.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Recovery signal, exploring potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.71x) + Decreased confidence in price movement, subdued volume.
· Current zone diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + Conditions for entry: Consider buying if RSI recovers above 40 and volume exceeds 1.2x.
